payload.title: Appointment Reminder Text Templates: 6 to Copy and Paste
payload.description:
Appointment reminder text templates you can copy and paste, plus the timing and settings that send them for you before every visit.

00:00 Why reminder texts matter
00:38 Turn on automatic reminders
01:35 Text, email or both
02:30 When to send reminders
03:55 Six templates to copy and paste
05:52 Add a confirm or cancel reply
07:10 Test it on your own booking
08:08 Find your no-show count
09:08 Recap

Create your account: https://www.example.com/signup/
Reminder settings guide: https://www.example.com/features/reminders/
More no-show tips on the blog: https://www.example.com/blog/reduce-no-shows/

Every booking gets an automatic text before the visit, and clients can reply to confirm or cancel. The video covers turning reminders on, choosing text, email or both, when to send them, the six templates, adding a confirm or cancel reply, testing it on your own booking, and finding your no-show count in the dashboard.

#appointmentreminders #salonowner #smallbusiness
